Telstra questions

What is the cheapest Telstra NBN plan?

Essential NBN 50 at $69/mo for 6 months, then $99/mo. That is $1,008 over the first year (checked 8 October 2026).

Does Telstra let you opt out of CGNAT?

Not for free. Telstra only offers a public IP through a paid static IP add-on.

Do you need to give Telstra 30 days notice to cancel?

No. Telstra doesn't require a 30-day notice period to cancel.

Which mobile network does Telstra use?

Telstra runs on the Telstra Retail, which covers about 99.6% of Australians.

Has Telstra raised its prices recently?

We haven't recorded any ongoing price rises for Telstra since 10 August 2026. Promo prices have changed; see the table above.
